mapper.select: SELECT e.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(u.username, u.email) AS who FROM class_enrollments e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.role_in_class = 'TEACHER' ORDER BY e.class_id, u.id
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.term, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM class_enrollments e WHERE e.class_id = c.id AND e.role_in_class = 'STUDENT') AS students FROM classes c ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO classes (id, name, term) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{term})
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.username, u.email, e.role_in_class AS roleInClass, e.joined_at AS joinedAt FROM class_enrollments e JOIN users u ON u.id = e.user_id WHERE e.class_id = #{classId} ORDER BY e.role_in_class, e.joined_at, u.id
SELECT id FROM users WHERE LOWER(email) = LOWER(#{who}) OR LOWER(username) = LOWER(#{who}) ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_enrollments (class_id, user_id, role_in_class) VALUES (#{classId}, #{userId}, #{roleInClass})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM class_enrollments WHERE class_id = #{classId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes WHERE id = #{classId}
